facts.note: Mafia, also known as Werewolf, is a social deduction game created in 1986 by Dmitry Davidoff, then a psychology student at Moscow State University.

facts.claim: 연구용으로 수업에 들여왔고 기숙사·여름 캠프로 퍼짐
facts.note: Davidoff says that he brought Mafia into the Psychology department classrooms for research and it spread (as a meme) from there to dormitories and likely over next summer, through student summer camps.
In 1997, the werewolf theme was added to the game by Andrew Plotkin ... the werewolf concept fit the idea of a hidden enemy who looked normal during the daytime.

facts.claim: 1990년대 중반 라트비아에서 의회 배경·유명인 출연 TV 시리즈
facts.note: By the mid 1990s, a version of the game became a Latvian television series with a parliamentary setting, and played by Latvian celebrities.

question.hintNote: In 2016, a film, Mafia: The Game of Survival was made in Russia based on the game; however, it received negative reviews.
